preservation_statement: All original mathematical sources, documentation, source/declaration mappings, verification inputs, axiom log, and results report are preserved byte-for-byte. The only unavailable original file is the short build timing log; it is replaced by complete genuine build output from the separately identified fresh GitHub verification run.

exact_report_recovery.method: Deterministic reconstruction using the preserved original axiom log, original verification script and ordering, preserved current source/input data, and unchanged parent data. The reconstructed bytes were accepted only after matching the pre-recorded original byte size, Git blob SHA, and SHA-256.
exact_report_recovery.independent_review: The report matches all 10219 unique original declaration records, 422 imported project modules, 25 external modules, 1229 registered results, 273 component proof lists, 1214 recovered mappings, all 423 source hashes, and all 43 verification-input hashes.

unavailable_original_artifacts.reason: The temporary working directory disappeared after all sources, documentation, provenance, verifier, and axiom log had been uploaded, but before this file was uploaded.

fresh_verification.log_extraction: The complete decoded GitHub job log is preserved without modification. Derived build and audit payloads remove only anchored GitHub timestamp prefixes, including observed BOMs immediately preceding timestamps; payload whitespace, blank lines, and final newlines are retained. The extracted fresh audit was compared byte-for-byte with the exact original axiom log.
